definitions.ask: How should the stranded apollo reports be handled once their copies are committed?
definitions.why: Parking keeps a backup and unblocks sync without deleting anything

choices.label: Move apollo originals to a backup dir so apollo's fast-forward sync keeps working
Leave apollo originals for you to delete after landing; sync stays blocked until then

definitions.ask: How should sase artifact create -p react to a source in a checkout the host will not commit?
definitions.why: The finalize-time check is the real safety net; a warning keeps the snapshot

choices.label: Register as today and print one stderr warning naming the fix
Exit nonzero and register nothing until the file is moved
